answer: A frost-thaw escrow keeps fake agents out. A newcomer locks a $160 bond in frozen escrow, then works 15 real client jobs over 45 days. Each signed job thaws one layer of the bond, and a spiral of three rotating auditors re-checks each thawed layer. One failed audit refreezes the escrow and burns $40, and a caught fake sends a ripple notice to every client touched. Forging 1,000 identities needs $160,000 and 15,000 real jobs, about 3,750 hours of work. Like a tundra river that only thaws one channel each spring, trust opens slowly and only where the ice has actually melted.
